other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be at least 18 years old
Account can be opened on behalf of a minor who is 10 years old or older
Minor must convert the account to his/her own name after reaching the age of majority (18)
Number of holders per account: minimum 1, maximum 3
Maximum investment limits: Single account ₹4,50,000; Joint account ₹9,00,000; Minor account ₹3,00,000
Applicant must have a Post Office savings account before opening a POMIS account
Nomination details (name, DOB, mobile number) must be provided
benefits_summary: Low‑risk, government‑backed scheme offering guaranteed monthly income with capital protection.
